name: Pause screen (Android overlay)
desc: Copy needs clinical/legal review. Drawn over the opened app by the foreground service (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW), 0.5–1.5 s after it opens. Get support opens Tether at Rescue. The typed-sentence and quick-sum steps use the same layouts as the in-app small-step states. Not an app route: reference for the native overlay.

body.text: You asked to slow this one down. Video apps is on your list.
Breathe with the circle. 2 of 3 “open anyway” left today.

notes: Native requirement: Get support opens Tether at Rescue and is always shown, whatever the level or overrides left. Native requirement (iOS shield and app selection, Android overlay, picker and service): never shield or pause Tether, the phone dialer or emergency calling, even if they are selected or a session pauses "everything". Needs device validation.
Reference surface: drawn natively or by the system; excluded from release-check counts, checked by device screenshots.
